proof_scope: 21 role-indexed client data ports routed to 13 physical 128-bit bank ports under bank owner authorization. XSIM uses behavioral memory; this module contains no storage or arithmetic.

checks.bank_pair_identity: PASS: both prefill and decode builder role-bank sets match contract, router and dispatcher
checks.verilator_lint: PASS with little-endian bus convention warning disabled

xsim_scenarios: DMA write and model-legal read of one bank
GEMM source/weight reads and destination write in one cycle on three banks
SOFTMAX role 14 reads and writes different addresses of B10 in one cycle
three-cycle read response alignment and simultaneous responses from two banks
first permitted and first forbidden address for each of 13 banks
owner mismatch, out-of-range bank, unsupported read role and forbidden role-bank pair rejected
limitations: No XPM storage, actual DataMover adapter or compute executor is instantiated in this module test.
OOC timing does not include clock source delay or placed/routed board timing.
Router faults must propagate through the future fabric to command failure; no successful DMA or compute completion may be emitted after a rejected bank request.
